name: Late supplier invoices -> unrecorded liabilities risk
rationale: A liability exists on receipt, not on invoicing; late invoices therefore create unrecorded liabilities. The rule directs two-directional cut-off testing around GRNs and inspection of management's accrual, targeting completeness and cut-off.
